title: Studio: customize a read-only package's view, dashboard or report into <base>.custom — a declared override, its badge, and "Restore package original" (replaces #28147)
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-17 customize view / dashboard / report (replaces #28147)". ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28410, #28407

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-17**) · governs: ADR-0146 D2 (the declaration, badge and revert), D3 ("Customize" lands in the pair without asking) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: M.

**Business reason.** An admin wants one more column on HotCRM's Accounts list. Today Studio shows the view greyed and sends them to Setup, which writes a row that never exports. With this card they press Customize in Studio, and the change becomes an item of `hotcrm.custom` that exports with its declaration. "Restore package original" brings HotCRM's view back.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:
  - `:1598` `readOnly` locks every Interfaces editor on a read-only package;
  - `StudioReadOnlyLink` (`:831`) sends an overlay-type item to Setup (#27927);
  - Pending and Publish read the open package (`usePendingDrafts` `:1705`, `publishPackageDrafts` `:1832`).
- N-13 (PR #28512, open) adds `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/ensure-customization`. `201` means created, `200` present, and a walled tenant admin gets `403`.
- N-10 (#28507): a read of X serves the pair row that declares `overrides.package` = X first (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#servedOverlayRowCandidates`). The layered read reports that row in `overlay`.
- `basedOn` comes from `studio-design/packages-io.ts:182#fetchListedPackageManifests`, whose rows carry `manifest: Record<string, unknown>` (:151–156). That the listed manifest carries `version`: not verified; if it does not, the dev reports the server gap, no client guess.

**WIP `adb2b4c6e6` (#28147, branch `claude/project-thread-3c7skj`).** Reusable:
- `StudioOverlayControls.tsx`: the chip, and a confirm dialog that says the draft is discarded;
- the `leafReadOnly` / `listViewReadOnly` split, which unlocks one leaf instead of the whole package;
- the rail-mark context and the per-item layered-read hook.

Not reusable: its writes target the read-only package's own row, gated on `allowEnvironmentOverlay` (the overlay model D2 superseded).

**Wanted.**
1. **Customize.** On a read-only base, it appears in the header of a view, dashboard or report item, and of an `object` leaf's list view. For a principal the ensure door refuses, it is disabled in the console's words, from the facts `setup/packagedFlowLedger.ts#useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly` reads. A server refusal is shown verbatim.
2. **First saved edit.** It calls the ensure door, with no prompt, then writes a draft into the pair:
   - the same type and name;
   - the layered `effective` body, without `_` keys;
   - `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, where `basedOn` is the base's `manifest.version`.
   The pair id comes from the ensure response, ⛔ never a local `.custom` spelling. An unedited Customize leaves nothing behind.
3. **Publish.** On a read-only base, the pending count, the changes panel and Publish act on the pair's drafts. N-09's refusal is shown verbatim.
4. **Badge.** The header says the item overrides HotCRM. It reads the served declaration, never a computation.
5. **Restore package original.** On the item menu: confirm, discard the draft, then delete the pair's item (`DELETE /meta/:type/:name` naming the pair). The base reads back. N-16b relies on this door.
6. **Link.** For these three types, `StudioReadOnlyLink` stops linking to Setup.

**Tests.** One ensure call per first edit. The pair draft carries the declaration and the base is untouched. A second item gets `200`. A walled admin sees Customize disabled. Publish targets the pair. Restore brings back the base's columns. A writable package is unchanged. Each item has an ablation.

**Release safety.** Safe alone: N-09 judges the declaration (#28410), and only N-13 creates the pair (#28407). An unmigrated package-less row stays stored, shadowed by the override on X's reads; #28413's ceremony lists it as shadowed with both ways out.

**Not here.** Rail marks, filter, switcher fold, New (N-19). Flows (N-18). Translations and email templates (N-25). The rest of the link and closing the package-less write (N-16b). Migration (N-16a).

**Dedupe.** #28147 (closed, replaced). Searched `studio customize view custom package`, `restore package original`: only epic siblings.

Links back: #28236, #28147, #28407, #28410, #28507, ADR-0146 D2, D3.
